name: io.github.Ermag/rowbit
title: Rowbit
description: Preview, approve and undo AI agents' writes to MariaDB and MySQL

runtimeArguments.name: --interactive
runtimeArguments.description: Keep standard input open: the agent talks to Rowbit over it

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the agent client stops it

rowbit_dir.description: The directory `rowbit setup` made, such as /home/you/.rowbit/default (a full path)

runtimeArguments.name: --user
runtimeArguments.description: Run as the owner of Rowbit's files, so it can read them (needed on Linux)

uid_gid.description: Your user and group ids as uid:gid, from `id -u` and `id -g`, such as 1000:1000

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: The agent's id in rowbit.yml; `rowbit setup` names agents after clients, such as claude-code or cursor
